qualification_implementation_boundary: A1 requires completed Q dispositions, including manifest-bound actual B and all N scenario identities, assets/counters/dimensions/capacity/preparation/parity before I1. Candidate operations, new extras and installed profiles remain I1/I2/I3/AG. Deterministic operational vectors are not a replacement for real serving qualification.
not_claimed: No completed Gate A, construction approval, runtime test, installed profile, council/UAT execution or acceptance is inferred from this map.
path_list_semantics: exit_assertions.implemented_paths lists primary source seams, not an exhaustive file partition or independent allowlist. Before generation A2 assigns every selected parent-authorized path to slice/owner/purpose/exit and A3 binds tests/helpers; an unassigned path blocks that slice.
intermediate_regression_rule: Any unwaived regression in previously supported unchanged scope blocks the current slice exit; a later planned repair is not a waiver. Only an exact maintainer-approved changed baseline/temporary integration exception with replacement coverage can permit exit. Missing clearly later features are not falsely certified or used to excuse broken old paths.
intermediate_I1_compatibility: Before I1 activation A2 freezes an additive staging design: new typed contracts, guarded entry/factory and direct positive/refusal tests without changing existing maintained callers to require an unprovided binding before I2 wiring. Existing baseline flows must still pass I1. This is not final permission for an unguarded direct opener or a released legacy mode. If exact public shapes/file scope cannot support additive staging, stop before I1 and obtain a named maintainer-approved integration exception and coverage; no blanket temporary waiver. Preparation/role/cache-space changes are also staged: legacy/unbound inputs and vectors stay unchanged in I1, with paired I1-C2 witnesses; only newly guarded qualified paths use new preparation, until I2 binds and switches actual existing callers.
